component.name: Overlock font families
component.summary: Overlock sans fonts with LaTeX support

description.p: The package provides the Overlock and OverlockSC families of fonts, designed by Dario Manuel Muhafara of the TIPO foundry (http://www.tipo.net.ar), "rounded" sans-serif fonts in three weights (Regular, Bold, Black) with italic variants for each of them. There are also small-caps and old-style figures in the Regular weight.
